entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 2603370653827638656: position at J2016.0. Distance: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 112716: distance 97.371 pc, the paper's parallax inverted (Gaia DR1's where it revised the star's, else the Hipparcos reduction of van Leeuwen 2007; section 2.3; fractional uncertainty 0.028), at which the luminosity and radius hold (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433): 97.371 +/- 2.726 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 10.0171 +/- 0.1734 mas (same row, RUWE 1.65), 57.8 standard errors, is not used. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): -13.386, -38.609 mas/yr. Radial velocity from SIMBAD's radial velocity for Gaia DR3 2603370653827638656 (quality A), from 2006AstL...32..759G; Gaia DR3 measures none.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 50.996 solar radii from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 112716: radius 50.996 solar radii, implied by the fitted luminosity 543.303 solar luminosities (fractional uncertainty 0.07) and temperature (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433). No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 3905 +/- 125 K from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 112716: effective temperature 3905 +/- 125 K, from the fit of a model atmosphere to the star's spectral energy distribution (goodness of fit Q 0.106).
